subject: Re: Handshake & vendor setup — quick recap + next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rodriguez <s.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handshake & vendor setup — quick recap + next steps

Thanks again for the time today, Sam — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for Atlas Health internal care-assist workflows (phase 1: 50k tokens/day).
- Success metrics: sub-200ms median token latency for key endpoints; cost target ~ $0.003/token.
- Action items we agreed:
  1) I will share a short MAP (mutual action plan) and vendor setup checklist (attached).
  2) Atlas procurement will initiate vendor onboarding and send the portal invite to the Redwood vendor contact.
  3) You mentioned ACH + W-9 are required to finish provisioning — happy to get those in whatever format your portal requires.

Attachments: Redwood-Handshake-MAP.pdf (3 pages), Vendor-Setup-Checklist.xlsx (sheet listing fields we typically need).

Would appreciate an ETA on when procurement will open the vendor slot so our ops team can prepare the runtime environment and reserve the dedicated pool. If it helps I can also loop in our Finance ops (Ben) to handle the W-9/ACH details directly.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Rodriguez <s.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handshake & vendor setup — quick recap + next steps

Thanks Marcus — great call. I've looped in procurement (procurement@atlashealth.com) and they should send the vendor portal invite today or Monday at the latest.

Couple quick notes:
- Procurement usually needs the vendor's legal name, remit-to address, and a W-9. If you can attach the W-9 to the portal that's ideal; otherwise I can accept a PDF via email temporarily.
- ACH setup is a separate form inside the portal; procurement will kick that off once the vendor record is created.

I'll follow up if procurement needs anything else from our side. Appreciate you sending the MAP and checklist.

— Sam
Sam Rodriguez
Head of Product, Atlas Health
sam.rodriguez@atlashealth.com | (212) 555-0142

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: procurement@atlashealth.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sam Rodriguez <s.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup follow-up — Atlas / Redwood (drive-by bump)

Hi procurement team —Marcus here from Redwood. Quick bump on the portal invite/next steps for Atlas Health vendor setup. We sent the MAP and checklist to Sam on 3/18 (attached) and are standing by to: upload a W-9, complete ACH details, and accept your T&Cs.

To make it easy, I attached our signed W-9 (Atlas-W9.pdf) and a one-page onboarding checklist; if you prefer us to complete fields directly in the portal please send the invite to vendor-admin@redwood.com.

If there's any missing field or additional paperwork to speed this up let me know — we generally can turn around the W-9/ACH in <24 hours once we have the portal link.

Thanks for the help — would love an ETA so we can book a warm-up window with infra.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: Atlas-W9.pdf (fillable W-9)
From: procurement@atlashealth.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rodriguez <s.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup follow-up — Atlas / Redwood (drive-by bump)

Hi Marcus — thanks for the follow-up and for sending the W-9. A quick status update from procurement: 

- We created the vendor record this morning and have queued the portal invite. The invite is currently pending admin verification (internal step) and should dispatch by EOD 2027-03-31 if verification completes as expected.
- Once you receive the portal invite, please upload the W-9 there and complete the ACH form. The portal link will include step-by-step prompts; we cannot finalize the payment profile until both documents are submitted inside the portal.
- If the portal verification hits a blocker we'll escalate, but for planning assume a 24–48 hour window after invite to finish the onboarding (assuming documents uploaded promptly).

Portal invite ETA: 2027-03-31 EOD (tentative). If you prefer, you can expedite by confirming the vendor admin email (vendor-admin@redwood.com) so the invite goes to the right inbox.

Regards,
Atlas Health Procurement (automated@atlashealth.com)
procurement@atlashealth.com

Related Link: https://vendors.atlashealth.com/invite/xyz
